Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looks drained after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、元気がなさそうだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来没什么精神。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起來沒什麼精神。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble épuisé après l'échec de la quête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sah nach dem Scheitern der Mission erschöpft aus.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecía sin ánimo.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecia desanimada.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ดูเหมือนว่า <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> จะดูไม่มีเรี่ยวแรงหลังจากทำภารกิจล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terlihat lesu setelah gagal dalam misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trông có vẻ kiệt sức sau khi thất bại trong nhiệm vụ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: अनुरोध में विफल होने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> हतोत्साहित दिख रही थी।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wir werden eine weitere Chance haben.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไว้คราวหน้าก็แล้วกันนะคะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Mari kita coba lagi lain kali.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Chúng ta sẽ có cơ hội khác.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 그래도 수고했어. 이거 마시고 다음엔 더 힘내자.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: You still did well. Drink this, and let's do better next time.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: とにかく、お疲れ様。これ飲んで次はもっと頑張ろう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 你已经很努力了。喝了这个，下次我们一起加油。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 你已經很努力了。喝了這個，下次我們一起加油。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tu as quand même bien travaillé. Bois ceci, et faisons mieux la prochaine fois.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Du hast es trotzdem gut gemacht. Trink das, und beim nächsten Mal geben wir mehr Gas.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Aun así, lo hiciste bien. Bebe esto y esforcémonos más la próxima vez.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Você ainda se saiu bem. Beba isto e vamos nos esforçar mais da próxima vez.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: แต่ก็ยังทำได้ดีอยู่ดีค่ะ ดื่มนี่ซะ แล้วคราวหน้าเรามาพยายามให้มากกว่านี้กันนะคะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kau sudah melakukan yang terbaik. Minumlah ini, dan mari kita lakukan lebih baik lain kali.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Dù sao thì cô cũng đã làm tốt rồi. Uống cái này đi, lần sau chúng ta sẽ làm tốt hơn.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: फिर भी तुमने अच्छा किया। इसे पियो, और अगली बार और बेहतर करते हैं।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> swore to protect her allies even more resolutely next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、隙を見せずに仲間を守りきると、固く心に誓った
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>下定决心要更严密地保护同伴。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>下定決心要更嚴密地保護同伴。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a juré de protéger ses alliés sans laisser la moindre faille la prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> schwor, ihre Verbündeten beim nächsten Mal noch lückenloser zu beschützen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> juró proteger a sus aliados con aún más resolución la próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> jurou proteger seus aliados sem deixar brechas da próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สาบานว่าจะปกป้องพันธมิตรของเธออย่างรัดกุมยิ่งขึ้นในครั้งต่อไป
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bersumpah untuk melindungi sekutunya dengan lebih gigih lain kali.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thề sẽ bảo vệ đồng minh của mình kiên quyết hơn nữa vào lần tới.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अगली बार अपने सहयोगियों की बिना कोई चूक किए रक्षा करने की शपथ ली।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: A fleeting shadow passed over <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s face.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 一瞬、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の顔に暗い影が差した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Une ombre fugace passa sur le visage de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ein flüchtiger Schatten huschte über <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Gesicht.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Una sombra fugaz pasó por el rostro de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Uma sombra passageira cruzou o rosto de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เงามืด ๆ พาดผ่านใบหน้าของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> แวบหนึ่ง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Bayangan gelap sesaat melintas di wajah <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Một bóng tối thoáng qua trên khuôn mặt của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के चेहरे पर एक क्षण के लिए अंधेरी छाया छा गई।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> était ravi(e) de recevoir la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se alegró al recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou após receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> รู้สึกดีขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tươi tỉnh hẳn lên sau khi nhận được thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
